summary: CustomReportQueue is an ASP.NET Web User Control for managing custom report requests within the HSPnet system. It provides a multi-step interface for administrators and users to view, filter, manage, and act upon requests. It implements grid-based navigation, controls for agency/department/user selection, workflow actions, file uploads, and status-based operation visibility.
purpose: To facilitate the viewing, filtering, and processing of custom report requests by authorized users. It enables administrative actions (approve, refuse, return, cancel, complete) and includes mechanisms for file attachment, validations, user communication, and workflow visibility.

workflows.name: CustomReport Request Processing
steps: Dropdowns bind Agency, Department, User based on UserSession
User can filter by Created date, Agency, Department, User
CustomReport queue displayed in rprCustomReport grid
User can edit (cmdEdit), return (cmdReturnToUser), cancel (cmdCancelRequest), refuse (cmdRefuseRequest), complete (cmdCompleteRequest) requests, depending on status and privileges
Details popup (mdlDetails) allows file uploads and document viewing
File uploaded via HandleUploadedFile, saved to uniquely created folder; metadata updated via UpdateFile
Workflow buttons are enabled/disabled or hidden depending on StatusCode and user role
Grid refreshes after actions or at user request (cmdRefreshView)
Sort operations (cmdSortCreatedDate, cmdSortRequestedByDate, cmdSortUserName) update ViewState and grid presentation
Communication to requester via email popup (cmdReturnToUser)

business_rules: Only SystemAdministrator and/or request owner can cancel pending requests
Buttons/actions visibility is determined by request status code and user privileges
Dropdowns are dynamically populated, blank entry added if multiple options
PreviousYears entry shown for ddCreated if user is an administrator
Sorting is managed via ViewState, toggling ASC/DESC per action
Details shown/hidden based on chkShowDetails and data presence
validations: ValidationSummary3 used for displaying validation issues
FormView row must have valid document metadata before saving
conditions: Show details row if chkShowDetails is checked
Show additional row if Comments are not empty
Add blank dropdown entry if more than one item
system_behavior: RefreshData rebinds dropdowns and grid, maintaining user selections
Page_Load and Page_PreRender set up initial state and reset view state
Actions update backend via CustomReports API calls
dependencies: Resources for localized strings and prompts
Grid utility for UI control management
exceptions: HandleUploadedFile returns false if file upload fails
SaveDocument only completes if no errors are present in UserSession.Messages
content_gaps: No explicit database schema for CustomReport entity found
No field-level data validation logic detailed other than file upload
No explicit error handling for API failures
No description of UI layout or styling
